formatted_text: <description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> Hi, thanks for calling. I am sorry you are dealing with this. I can take your first notice of loss right now.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> You are safe, and we can go step by step. There is no rush.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> First, is anyone hurt, even a little?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> I am really sorry that happened. We will get this claim started so someone can help you from here.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If you need an ambulance or you are still in the roadway, please say so and we will pause the claim questions.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Thank you for calling this in. You did the right thing.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I am going to file this as a personal auto first notice of loss, and I will write the details into the claim as we talk.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Can I start with the name on the policy?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> And were you the one driving, or are you calling for someone else?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Got it. I have you as the driver on the loss.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> When did this happen? Even an approximate time is fine.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Where were you when it happened? City and a street or intersection is enough.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Take your time and tell me what happened, from the start. I am listening.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> That sounds sudden. I am with you. Let me make sure I have the sequence right.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was this on the open road, in a parking lot, or at an intersection?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> About how fast were you going, if you can estimate?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was there another vehicle involved?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If you do not have all of that, that is okay. We can add it later.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> How many people were in your vehicle, including you?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did anyone need an ambulance, or is everyone walking and talking?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I am glad to hear no one needed an ambulance. I will still note that we asked, and that you said no injuries that you know of.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did the airbags deploy?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Can you describe the damage you can see? Front bumper, side, or something else?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Is the car drivable, or do you need a tow?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did police come to the scene, and do you have a report number?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> No report yet is fine. I will mark that police were not on scene, or that the number is still coming.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I am sorry to ask a few more details. It helps the claim get routed to the right person.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Personal auto loss today near Fifth and Congress in Austin. Two vehicles. No ambulance. Front bumper damage. You were driving.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Thank you. I have that captured.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Your claim number is one eight four two dash nine zero six. I can repeat that slowly.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> One eight four two, dash, nine zero six.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> I know this is a lot after an accident. You do not have to remember every detail today.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If you need to step away, say so. I will wait.
<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I have that.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Are you still there?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Sorry, the line got quiet for a second. I am still here.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Could you say that one more time, a little slower? I want to get it right.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> I hear that this has been stressful. Let me stay with the facts we need so we can finish this call for you.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> What is the best number if an adjuster needs to reach you later today?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Is there anything else about the loss I should put on the file before we close?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> You are all set. The first notice is in, and the claim is already being routed. I hope the rest of your day is easier from here.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Take care. Someone from claims will follow up with you.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> I know calling after a crash is hard. We can keep this to what we need for the first notice.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Breathe. I have the claim open. You can talk it through in your own words.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was this a rear-end, a side swipe, or something else?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did this happen in a parking lot while someone was backing out?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> If the other driver left the scene, I am sorry. We can still file this as a hit and run.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Do you remember a color, a make, or even a partial plate?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> A silver sedan and no plate is still useful. I will put that on the file.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Is this glass only, like a cracked windshield, or is there body damage too?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I will set this as a glass claim so it can route to the right team.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was weather a factor? Rain, ice, or standing water?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did an animal run into the road?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> That can happen fast. I will file this as a single-vehicle animal strike.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was anyone else in the car with you? A passenger, a child, a coworker?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> I am sorry your passenger is sore. I will note possible injury so claims can follow up with care.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If they later need to see a doctor, that can still be added. You do not have to decide that on this call.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> What is the year, make, and model of your vehicle?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Can you read the last six of the VIN if you have the insurance card handy?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If you do not have the VIN, we can still file. Policy can fill that in.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Where is the car now? Still at the scene, at home, or at a shop?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Do you need a rental while the car is in the shop?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I will flag rental on the claim so someone can check your coverage and set that up.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did you take any photos of the cars, the street, or the other driver?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Keep those photos. You can send them after this call. I will note that pictures exist.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was there a witness who stopped, or a store camera nearby?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I have to ask about fault in a simple way. This is not a final decision, just what you saw.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> From your view, who made contact first?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> You can say you are not sure. Uncertainty is allowed on a first notice.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> If the other driver was uninsured, I hear you. We can still start the claim and check coverage.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Do you have an email where I can send the claim number when we finish?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Please confirm the street address we have on the policy, including the zip code.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Was this during a commute, a personal errand, or something else?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> About what time did you leave the scene, if you already have?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If you are still at the scene, stay somewhere safe, off the travel lanes if you can.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> The first notice is structured now. Loss date, location, vehicles, injuries, and damage are on the file.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I appreciate you staying with me through the details. That helps the next person help you faster.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> If you start to feel shaken later, that is normal. The claim number is yours to keep.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Would you like me to repeat the claim number one more time?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Is there a preferred shop, or should claims suggest one near you?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I will leave shop choice open so you are not locked in on this call.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> I am sorry if I asked the same thing twice. I wanted the file to be clean.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> If I misunderstood the other vehicle, please correct me. I would rather fix it now.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Okay. I have the correction.
<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Thank you.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Whenever you are ready.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Can you say the street name again?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> I am sorry the other person raised their voice at the scene. You are safe on this call.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> We do not need to argue fault here. Just what you experienced is enough for first notice.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Were the lights working at the intersection, as far as you could tell?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Were you turning, going straight, or stopped?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Did you feel one impact or more than one?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Any warning lights on the dash now, or is the car running normally?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Thank you for walking me through this. The first notice is complete, and you can hang up when you are ready.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> You did what you needed to do. The claim is in motion now.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Goodbye. Please be safe getting home.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> Hi, I can help you file a first notice of loss. Are you somewhere safe to talk?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> This is just the first notice. An adjuster will still review coverage and next steps.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> No forms. No phone tree. You talk, and I capture the claim.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <curious> Should I start with injuries, or with what happened?

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> <sigh> We will start with whether you are okay. The rest of the claim can wait thirty seconds.

<description="Warm empathetic American adult female claims agent, calm mid pitch, unhurried realistic phone pacing, natural first-notice-of-loss delivery without brightness or laughter"> Thanks for trusting me with this. I will treat the details carefully.
